newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Opposition wins control over Belgrade - official.
newsitem.headline: Opposition wins control over Belgrade - official.

text.p: The Belgrade election commission confirmed on Tuesday that the opposition Zajedno coalition had won control over the Serbian capital Belgrade in Sunday's municipal elections.
"Zajedno won 60 seats, the Socialist Party of Serbia 23, the Serbian Radical Party 15 and the Serbian Democratic Party won two," commission chairman Dragoslav Lazarevic told reporters.
Lazarevic said voting would be repeated for 10 counsellors next Sunday. The city assembly has 110 seats.
Lazarevic said the overall turnout for Belgrade was 41.27 percent of voters.

Tensions ran high across Serbia on Tuesday as thousands of opposition supporters demonstrated in the city of Nis fearing the authorities would resort to massive fraud in local elections to deny them victory.
Nis was among several cities where the opposition Zajedno (Together) coalition claimed to have swept the ruling Socialists and their allies from power.
